Reply/thread/silent/reference supported; typed source room token can be supplied for a private reply. For a quoted reply in a thread the adapter validates the parent belongs to that thread and sends replyTo alone; Talk derives the thread from its topmost parent. Object/share metadata uses separate operations. No guest actorDisplayName override. Source: spreed stable34 and stable35 lib/Controller/ChatController.php sendMessage/resolveReplyTo and lib/Chat/ChatManager.php sendMessage.

Bounded history/context and finite future reads with safe read/privacy defaults. UnreadAfter uses a nonnegative lastKnownMessageId, lookIntoFuture=1 and timeout=0. The adapter handles the first-unread sentinel with a bounded backward history scan because released Talk returns an empty future poll for zero. No destructive chat long-poll owner. Source: spreed stable34 and stable35 lib/Controller/ChatController.php receiveMessages.
